entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. Order number is VF88301.
Okay, I'm pulling that up now. I see an order for the Pro-Level Cycling Shoes. Is that the item?
I can help with that. To be sure I'm routing this correctly, could you tell me what the specific issue with the shoes is?
They don't fit right. I wore them once and they gave me terrible blisters. I want a refund.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Discomfort like blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Just to confirm, have the cleats been installed on the cycling shoes?
No. I wasn't going to install the cleats until I was sure. I'm not an idiot.
Of course not, that's perfectly understandable. Let me just check the policy against your purchase date. I see you received them 65 days ago. One moment.
Alright, thank you for your patience. I've confirmed that your order is unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can go ahead and process this return for a full refund for you.
Whatever. Just send me the label.

Certainly. I have just emailed a pre-paid return label to the address on file. Once our warehouse receives the shoes, we will issue the refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Okay. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
